_about: English words for the challenge board page (tools/site/pages/challenge.mjs, served at /c/<id>/). Placeholders: {n} (a count), {airport} (the airport code, in the tab title). The page is English only.
title: Challenge board | Short Final
description: The top scores on one Short Final challenge board: each player's best score, with the airport and the level.
leadLink: A friend set a score on this challenge. Play the same planes and see if you can beat the top of the board.
leadNoLink: Each player's best score on one challenge. Short Final is a free air traffic game for Android.
empty: No one has posted a score on this challenge yet. Be the first to play it in Short Final.
error: We could not load this board right now. Check your connection, then try again.
invalid: This address is not a challenge board. Check the link you were sent, or play a new challenge in Short Final.
noscript: Turn on JavaScript to see this challenge board. The Play button above works without it.
playNote: Short Final is free on Google Play. A challenge link opens straight in the game on a phone that has it installed.
names: Names show only where a player has chosen to show them. Everyone else appears as Pilot and four digits. Scores come from ranked games.
